say:2:1530718001:1.text: Really? I never thought I'd see you again!
say:2:1530718001:1.source_cn: 竟然真的是你，没想到还能见到你！
say:2:1530718001:1.male: Really? I never thought I'd see you again!
say:2:1530718001:1.female: Really? I never thought I'd see you again!

say:3:1530718002:1.text: What are you talking about, Rotcrest? Who is this?
say:3:1530718002:1.source_cn: 你在说什么啊毒冠，他是谁？

say:4:1530718003:1.text: Have you forgotten the great mage who kept us from starving with wheat?
say:4:1530718003:1.source_cn: 你忘了吗？全靠他当年留下的麦田，食物才没那么短缺？
say:4:1530718003:1.male: Have you forgotten the great mage who kept us from starving with wheat?
say:4:1530718003:1.female: Have you forgotten the great mage who kept us from starving with wheat?
